body.text: Remove the release rule: moving quickly must no longer drop Cargo. Only acquiring Cargo should require a slow approach. Leave Player movement unchanged.
Add a release condition to the existing Cargo connection: when Player speed exceeds 0.5, detach Cargo and leave it where it was. Keep the current slow pickup conditions and Player movement.

body.reply: The rule that detached Cargo when moving quickly has been removed. Cargo will now remain attached regardless of your speed.
I've updated the rule for object B. Now, it will detach when your speed exceeds 0.5, in addition to the existing conditions for pickup.
